opsAnalyticsQuery.sql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT timestamp, SAFE.PARSE_JSON(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.message)) AS m
  FROM `__PROJECT__.global._Default._AllLogs`
  WHERE timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
    AND log_name IN ('projects/__PROJECT__/logs/stdout', 'projects/__PROJECT__/logs/dataflow.googleapis.com%2Fworker') AND JSON_VALUE(json_payload.logger) = '__LOGGER__'),
entries AS (
  SELECT JSON_VALUE(m.COB_COLUMN) AS cob, JSON_VALUE(m.RUN_ID_COLUMN) AS run_id, JSON_VALUE(m.STATUS_COLUMN) AS status,
         JSON_VALUE(m.BOOK_COLUMN) AS book, JSON_VALUE(m.SYSTEM_COLUMN) AS system, JSON_VALUE(m.SOURCE_COLUMN) AS source,
         JSON_VALUE(m.PROCESS_COLUMN) AS process, JSON_VALUE(m.ENTITY_COLUMN) AS entity,
         JSON_VALUE(m.ERROR_COLUMN) AS error, SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(m.MEMBERS_COLUMN) AS INT64) AS members,
         SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(m.EVENT_TIME_COLUMN) AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_at,
         COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(m.WRITE_TIME_COLUMN) AS TIMESTAMP), timestamp) AS updated_at
  FROM r WHERE m IS NOT NULL AND IF(@Source = '*', TRUE, JSON_VALUE(m.SOURCE_COLUMN) = @Source)),
picked AS (SELECT IF(@COB = '*', MAX(cob), @COB) AS cob FROM entries),
runs AS (
  SELECT run_id, ANY_VALUE(cob) AS cob, ANY_VALUE(book) AS book, ANY_VALUE(source) AS source, ANY_VALUE(system) AS system,
         ARRAY_AGG(status ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS status,
         MIN(COALESCE(event_at, updated_at)) AS started, MAX(updated_at) AS ts,
         ARRAY_AGG(error IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1)[SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS error
  FROM entries GROUP BY run_id),
books AS (
  SELECT book, ARRAY_AGG(status ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS status, MIN(started) AS started,
         MAX(ts) AS ts, COUNT(*) AS runs, ARRAY_AGG(error IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1)[SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS last_error
  FROM runs WHERE cob = (SELECT cob FROM picked) GROUP BY book),
prev AS (SELECT DISTINCT book FROM runs WHERE cob = (SELECT MAX(cob) FROM runs WHERE cob < (SELECT cob FROM picked))),
not_started AS (SELECT book FROM prev WHERE book NOT IN (SELECT book FROM books))
SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(MAX(ts), MINUTE) AS ts, COUNTIF(status IN ('FAILED_STATUS_1', 'FAILED_STATUS_2')) AS failed FROM runs WHERE cob = (SELECT cob FROM picked)
